summary: mission list --json / charter context emit LegacyOrgPackDoctrineKeyWarning for the legacy doctrine.org.packs key in .kittify/config.yaml on every call.
root_cause: Repo config still uses legacy doctrine.org.packs key
suggested_fix: Config-canonicalization pass to migrate the key

summary: Implementation sections of all three tracers were left as '(append as encountered)' placeholders; only planning-phase entries exist.
Filelock-site migration (WP05) was the highest-risk slice; a deferral seam was pre-agreed to ship WP01-04+WP06 with the ratchet still covering filelock sites.
root_cause: Cross-process + blocking-timeout parity for filelock cannot easily be proven on POSIX
suggested_fix: Red-first cross-process parity tests simulating Windows lock semantics; failing-parity test required as deferral evidence

summary: Testing OS-detection must patch the module attribute kernel.paths.is_windows; faking os.name='nt' flips pathlib to WindowsPath and crashes pytest.
root_cause: os.name patching changes pathlib class selection
suggested_fix: Route all OS detection through a patchable single-door seam

summary: Issue text undercounted the forks: 3 live safe-delete copies + 1 frozen migration, and 4 _is_windows sites (issue said 2); post-tasks review found 5 more uncounted OS-detection sites.
root_cause: Issue text written from a partial grep
suggested_fix: Re-count call sites in a grounding squad before spec

summary: Post-spec reviewer found a critical miss: asset_preparation.py's raw msvcrt/fcntl locking (#4703 origin) was absent from the migration FRs, making SC-003/SC-005 arithmetically unreachable.
suggested_fix: Keep post-spec adversarial review; it caught a critical scope gap

summary: Gate scope must be src/ only: copying the clock-ban template's (src,tests,scripts) scan would red ~51 lock and ~41 OS-detection legitimate test/script hits.
root_cause: Gate templates copied without scoping review
suggested_fix: Document divergence from template; per-WP exemption files; shrink-only ratchet seeded fail-closed

summary: Deferred: argv false-negative detectors in __init__.py (_is_next/_is_live_work_hook/_is_session_start) are latent and need a version bump; CWE-377 cold-sentinel generalization deferred as YAGNI.
suggested_fix: Track as separate follow-up

summary: Symlink risk: command surface materializes managed commands as symlinks; switching safe-delete to no-follow lstat could relocate PermissionError; required an SC-006 negative proof.
suggested_fix: Prove via real symlink-to-outside-tree delete test

summary: ensure_global_agent_commands() raises 'Global asset input changed' when a sibling-clone session regenerates the shared ~/.kittify/cache concurrently, crashing spec-commit/record-analysis/implement intermittently.
root_cause: Global cache shared across clones; gate treats concurrent regeneration as an error (fail-closed on a non-error)
suggested_fix: Treat 'input changed' as 'regenerate' rather than raise

summary: Workaround: spec-kitty next takes the _is_next_invocation fast path that skips the global-command gate; other verbs need a bounded retry loop.

implement WP01 wrote base_branch/base_commit into the WP01 prompt + meta/status without committing (auto-commit off); allocating WP02 then refused on 'Planning artifacts not committed' citing WP01's file.
root_cause: Allocator mutates planning artifacts as a side effect and leaves them dirty when auto-commit is off
suggested_fix: Per-lane allocation should auto-commit its own metadata write or not dirty cross-WP artifacts

summary: Mission auto-created with topology: coord for a 2-WP bug fix; status.events.jsonl churn on every transition must be committed on primary — heavier than needed.
root_cause: Topology default does not scale down for small fixes
suggested_fix: Default small fixes to flat/LANES topology

summary: CLAUDE.md instructed agents to read SPEC-KITTY-LEDGER.md but the file does not exist in the checkout.
root_cause: Instruction pointer outlived the file

summary: Three adversarial spec reviews still missed one line-citation drift (runtime_bridge.py:768-773 vs :763-767); plan-phase re-verification is not redundant.
suggested_fix: Keep a plan-phase citation re-verification pass

summary: gh pr view --json files silently truncates at 100 files; for PR #3923 (125 files) it hid the runtime_bridge_io.py touch, nearly invalidating the scope-narrowing evidence.
root_cause: gh CLI default pagination limit
suggested_fix: Use gh api with pagination for large PR file lists

summary: Spikes on placement_seam must query the actual MissionArtifactKind used by the call site; raise-or-not depends on the kind's partition.
suggested_fix: Query the real kind, not a representative stand-in

summary: record-analysis persisted verdict: unknown regardless of submitted carrier (SK-06) — reproduced twice then not on a third run; intermittent.
root_cause: Unknown; intermittent
suggested_fix: State self-computed verdict alongside persisted one

summary: mark-status has no --wp flag; subtask IDs collide across WPs so every in_progress->for_review transition on WP01 and WP02 needed --force (force_count 2 each).
root_cause: mark-status keyed only by task id
suggested_fix: Add WP scoping flag to mark-status (SK-135)

summary: finalize-tasks is topology-blind: wrote generic branch_strategy prose contradicting actual lanes.json routing; hand-corrected in commit 89550f775.
root_cause: finalize-tasks does not read meta.json topology/lanes when rendering branch_strategy
suggested_fix: Render branch_strategy from actual topology (SK-133)

summary: Gate counts on the mission branch before lane consolidation measured the unfixed tree and looked like a regression; nothing in spec-kitty output flags that approved lanes are not yet consolidated.
root_cause: Approved lane branches not yet merged; no tool signal about pending consolidation
suggested_fix: Record branch/commit alongside every gate count; tooling should warn when approved lanes are unconsolidated

summary: cd into a lane worktree persists across harness shell calls; subsequent spec-kitty state commands silently write to that worktree's frozen status copy and report OK, which looks like state corruption.
root_cause: CLI resolves state surface from cwd without warning when inside a lane worktree
suggested_fix: CLI should detect/refuse state writes from lane worktrees; agents verify pwd

summary: wps.yaml owned_files requires file-level disjointness, forcing plan's two WPs into one ~827-line, 12-subtask WP01, overriding sizing guidance.
root_cause: owned_files contract is file-granular
suggested_fix: Consider allowing dependency-ordered same-file ownership

summary: Baseline '(fast/unit tier)' label was ambiguous: bare -m 'fast or unit' gives 1666/325 while make test-fast markers give 1621/380 over the same dirs.
root_cause: Plan did not state the literal -m expression
suggested_fix: Cite exact pytest invocation strings in NFR baselines

summary: Draft PR #3923 degrades on MissionSelectorAmbiguous while this mission hard-blocks on the same exception from the same read; a future harmonization could silently revert FR-010.
root_cause: Two independently-authored anchoring mechanisms with opposite raise-vs-degrade policies
suggested_fix: Reconcile policy deliberately when the second PR lands; flagged in PR body

summary: Fix newly re-enables per-WP completion checks for every in-implement coord-topology mission (previously _should_advance_wp_step returned True unconditionally); operational discontinuity on merge.
root_cause: _should_advance_wp_step never received repo_root on coord topology so tasks/ lookup failed open
suggested_fix: Spot-check every in-implement coord mission after merge

summary: Lanes must be consolidated (lane-b then lane-a) before opening the PR; cite lane-a gate numbers, naming the branch for each count.
suggested_fix: Consolidate lanes before PR; name branch per count

summary: Mission was narrowed mid-flight from #3883+#3884 to #3884 after discovering draft PR #3923 already fixed #3883 independently; scope line must be 'Closes #3884' only.
root_cause: Parallel work not discovered before specify
suggested_fix: Search open PRs for the target seam before spec

summary: scripts/docs/build_cli_reference.py capture_help() hardcodes ('uv','run','spec-kitty'), re-syncing the env instead of using the built .venv.
root_cause: Script hardcodes uv run
suggested_fix: Make the runner configurable / use sys.executable

summary: hashlib.sha256 is TID251-banned repo-wide with no tests/ exemption; every legitimate file-integrity call site needs inline # noqa: TID251.
root_cause: Blanket ban with no sanctioned wrapper for raw file digests
suggested_fix: Provide a sanctioned kernel digest helper

summary: Lane worktrees have no .venv; agents must run the primary checkout's .venv binaries with PYTHONPATH=<lane>/src.
root_cause: Venv lives only at primary/workspace root
suggested_fix: Document or automate per-lane interpreter resolution

summary: Truncate-then-regrow ATDD fixture went red for the wrong reason (JSONDecodeError) until regrown lines were byte-length-identical so the stale offset lands on a line boundary.
root_cause: Fixture construction hazard: stale offset vs regrown file alignment
suggested_fix: Add byte-boundary alignment to WP ATDD-precision guidance

summary: diff-cover --cov= with a filesystem path silently collects zero coverage under PYTHONPATH resolution; the dotted module path is required.
root_cause: coverage.py treats path as not-imported module
suggested_fix: Document dotted --cov target

summary: safe-commit hard-ERRORs on kitty-specs/ edits from a lane branch without --to-branch, and its suggested remedy (checkout mission branch) would be wrong in a lane worktree.
root_cause: safe-commit auto-infers planning branch for kitty-specs paths and asserts HEAD against it
suggested_fix: Make the error suggest --to-branch <current-lane>; align warning vs error semantics

summary: '--to-branch will be required in v3.3' deprecation warning fires on every safe-commit call.
root_cause: Upcoming required flag
suggested_fix: Always pass --to-branch explicitly

summary: Shared workspace .venv editable install pointed at lane-a's src/, so pytest from lane-b would silently import another lane's code; worked around with PYTHONPATH rather than reinstalling.
root_cause: Single editable install shared across concurrent lane worktrees
suggested_fix: Verify specify_cli.__file__ before trusting runs; per-lane venv or PYTHONPATH guard

summary: Help string saying 'never --feature' tripped test_no_visible_feature_alias because the guard matches the literal token.
root_cause: Guard is literal-substring based
suggested_fix: Never write the literal --feature token in any user-visible string

summary: Registering a new top-level Typer group requires regenerating _completion_manifest.json; not in WP owned_files and only caught in integration-tests-cli tier.
root_cause: Hidden companion artifact of command registration
suggested_fix: Add _completion_manifest.json to owned_files alongside docs/api/cli-commands.md for new commands

summary: Function-level markers stack on module pytestmark; a git_repo test under a fast module was collected by fast tier and missed by integration tier.
root_cause: pytest marks stack, cannot be overridden per function
suggested_fix: Split into separate file per marker set

summary: tests/status/conftest _SEED_COUNTER is process-global, so seeding two feature_dirs in one test yields different ids and breaks byte-identical comparisons.
root_cause: Global counter in shared fixture helper
suggested_fix: Reset _SEED_COUNTER between seed passes (or make it resettable)

summary: First git_repo-tier run in a lane worktree triggers a one-time ~25s isolated test-venv build under .pytest_cache; not a hang.
Pre-existing mypy error in tests/status/conftest.py:124 (generator return type) surfaces when mypy'ing any status test; introduced by 6966cd6e95.
suggested_fix: Fix in a campsite pass

summary: A sibling mission was rejected (severity 4) for testing only mid-line-tear and not clean-boundary truncation; this mission split IC-02 into two independently failing-first tests.
suggested_fix: Require independent red-first tests per failure shape

summary: Core/shell split (tail_reader.py stdlib-only core with poll_once, shell only iterates) made termination-by-construction and deterministic truncation tests possible.
test_archive_root_byte_identical.py freezes all kitty-specs/ files at a fixed historical commit (fc4acaa897), blocking FR-009's required edits to a prior mission's contract docs.
root_cause: Archive-freeze gate pinned to an unrelated mission's base rev with a tiny exception list
suggested_fix: Write corrections as a new file in the live mission dossier (operator precedent); do not edit archived dossiers

summary: tasks.md is generated mechanically from wps.yaml with no freeform prose field; mission-wide notes (PR shape, cross-WP chokepoints, gate tables) had to be duplicated into WP prompt bodies.
root_cause: WorkPackageEntry has no notes field; generator has no prose injection point
suggested_fix: Add freeform per-WP / mission-level notes field to wps.yaml

summary: agent action implement blocked on missing analysis-report.md for three parallel WP agents; each reported BLOCKED because a mission-wide analyze is outside a WP implementer's mandate.
root_cause: Orchestrator dispatched WPs before running /spec-kitty.analyze
suggested_fix: Orchestrator must run analyze + record-analysis before WP dispatch

summary: record-analysis attempt failed on DIRTY_WORKTREE because sibling WP agents had uncommitted friction-tracer edits in the same checkout.
root_cause: Shared tracer file mutated concurrently by parallel agents
suggested_fix: Commit tracer entries promptly or give agents per-WP tracer sections

summary: requirement_refs frontmatter cannot express 'satisfied by omission' or constraints delivered by a subtask without a dedicated line; frontmatter is tool-owned so C-003/C-005/C-006 traceability only lives in prose.
root_cause: Generated-artifact expressiveness ceiling
suggested_fix: Add structured 'satisfied-by-omission' field to wps.yaml schema

summary: Dispatch wrapper told agents to pass --to-branch <merge_target_branch>; safe-commit asserts the worktree's current HEAD so the lane branch name is required. Hit independently by WP01 and WP03.
root_cause: Template/dispatch guidance conflates merge target with current lane branch
suggested_fix: Fix dispatch templates to name the lane branch for --to-branch

summary: test_create_mission_propagates_named_exception_type fails deterministically when pytest runs with cwd in a lane worktree (MissionCreationError: cannot create missions from inside a worktree).
root_cause: Worktree-detection guard fires against the test process's own cwd
suggested_fix: Tests should isolate cwd; or run baselines from primary checkout

summary: Concurrent pytest runs across sibling lanes evict each other's /tmp/pytest-of-<user>/pytest-NNN base dirs mid-run, producing ~66 cascading FileNotFoundError errors.
root_cause: Shared auto-numbered, auto-evicted pytest basetemp across concurrent worktrees
suggested_fix: Pass explicit --basetemp=<private dir> -p no:cacheprovider for concurrent agent runs

summary: tmpfs /tmp quota exhaustion (EDQUOT) from concurrent full-suite pytest runs took the session's Bash/Write tools offline for ~10-15 minutes.
root_cause: Many concurrent heavy test runs writing into a quota-limited shared tmpfs
suggested_fix: Route pytest tmp/cache/logs off tmpfs or cap concurrent full-suite runs

summary: A manual 'cmd &; wait' inside a Bash call is killed when the tool's 600s timeout fires even with nohup.
root_cause: Tool tears down the process group on timeout
suggested_fix: Use run_in_background: true for long runs

summary: A red-first fixture was legitimately green on literal main because the target was red only against an intermediate implementation; had to stage the fix to produce real red->green evidence.
suggested_fix: State explicitly when a fixture's red-ness is against an intermediate state rather than main

summary: Combining {REQUIRES,SUGGESTS} in one walk_edges call lets scope leak across a suggests-then-requires chain; resolve_context uses two separate single-relation walks.
root_cause: Reused the edges primitive but not the sibling's walk shape
suggested_fix: Mirror resolve_context's two separate walks

summary: Operator ruling claimed one mechanism fixes two named tests; empirically only one was reachable (#883 test depended on allowlist not closure walk); reported BLOCKED rather than widen allowlist.
root_cause: Ruling written without empirical check of each named test's path
suggested_fix: Verify each acceptance test's reachability before ruling

summary: Passing only the ruling-named tests was not sufficient; running full tests/charter surfaced two new regressions from an over-narrow reachability predicate; ownership (one-hop scope edge) was the correct simpler rule.
root_cause: Validated only named tests, not the broader suite
suggested_fix: Always run the full owning-subsystem suite after a ruling-scoped fix

summary: Always diff 'did I cause this' against the mission's true base commit, not your own prior commit; otherwise self-introduced regressions reclassify as pre-existing.
root_cause: Baseline taken against own first commit which already carried the defect
suggested_fix: Pin mission base commit for baseline attribution

summary: Pre-review regression gate on move-task --to for_review has a fixed 300s budget over a scope whose subset alone takes ~634s; timed out twice, needed --skip-pre-review-gate.
root_cause: Gate budget not calibrated to scope class (tests/charter+doctrine+charter_*)
suggested_fix: Raise budget for this scope class or shrink scope

summary: status emit --to for_review for a planning_artifact WP fails looking for a lane-planning branch that is never created; the only escape is --force which misrepresents the case.
root_cause: for_review ancestry check assumes a lane branch exists for every WP shape
suggested_fix: Recognize direct-on-target commits for planning_artifact WPs or provision lane-planning branch (SK-152/SK-146 class)

summary: Tracer headings are duplicated/misnumbered (two '## 4.', '## 7.'/'## 5.' pairs) from concurrent agents appending simultaneously.
root_cause: Parallel agents editing one append-only file
suggested_fix: Per-agent sections or serialized append

summary: Harness worktree-isolation sandbox resets cwd to an isolated worktree on an unrelated branch, refuses any command combining a redirect to the shared checkout with git (even '.github' substrings), and blocks Write/Edit on the shared checkout — contradicting the dispatch instruction.
root_cause: Harness isolation heuristics conflict with 'work in the exact checkout' dispatch
suggested_fix: Draft in scratchpad then cp into place; single 'cd && non-git' chains

summary: finalize-tasks --validate-only rejects owned_files under kitty-specs/ (INVALID_WP_OWNED_FILES_KITTY_SPECS) in both wps.yaml and WP frontmatter, though plan.md's Blast Radius listed such a file with no caveat.
root_cause: kitty-specs/ is planning territory excluded from ownership; plan/tasks-outline templates don't warn
suggested_fix: Document the constraint in tasks-outline prompt.md or mark kitty-specs touch points 'edited, not owned' in plan Blast Radius

summary: record-analysis silently persisted verdict: unknown with exit 0 when the analysis-findings/v1 carrier frontmatter was missing.
root_cause: No validation of the carrier block
suggested_fix: Reject or warn on missing carrier

summary: test_archive_root_byte_identical overruled the plan's (and two reviewers') decision to hand-edit an archived mission contract doc; docs had to move to the live dossier.
root_cause: Byte-freeze gate on pre-existing archive files is authoritative over in-repo precedent (250+ precedents)
suggested_fix: Put corrections in the live mission dossier; surface this rule at plan time

summary: SK-08 router rerank changes selection on every real dispatch; auto-routed calls in in-flight missions may resolve to different profiles before/after merge (accepted, unmitigated).
root_cause: route() is stateless and re-evaluated per call
suggested_fix: Pass explicit --profile for stable routing across a mission

summary: dry_run() implemented as a sibling method mirroring only invoke()'s read half so no truthy invocation_id is ever minted — safety by construction rather than a flag branch.
WP2 and WP3 edit the same statements in route(); WP3 is not guaranteed cleanly revertible independently.
tk-watch's --profile pin workaround for SK-08 becomes unnecessary after this fix but is left unmodified (C-004).
suggested_fix: Remove tk-watch pin in a follow-up

summary: CLAUDE.md's Shared Package Boundary line is not granular enough: _internal_runtime/ is a closed set of internalized DAG-engine re-exports, while the top level of src/runtime/next/ is where CLI-domain-importing orchestration lives.
suggested_fix: Refine CLAUDE.md guidance on which layer inside src/runtime/next/ to extend

summary: Baseline-red snapshot against #3284 (23 failures + 2 errors on full main) showed zero overlap with targeted shards; enables honest 'N introduced' claims per WP.
suggested_fix: Re-verify #3284 state before citing snapshot

summary: WP02 implement refused on dependencies_not_satisfied because WP01 had only a genesis->planned event despite its commit existing on the lane; agent used safe-commit directly, producing ACTIVE_WP_SCOPE_VIOLATION warnings on every commit.
root_cause: Orchestrator never emitted WP01 lifecycle transitions; lane active_wp context stuck
suggested_fix: Orchestrator must transition/approve predecessor WPs before dispatch; tooling could detect committed-but-planned WPs

summary: tests/_next_shard_map.py is a second, file-path-keyed marker authority; unregistered new files under the next roots get zero next_shard_N markers and are invisible to all integration-tests-next legs (default_fallback False).
root_cause: Shard registry separate from pytest markers; next group has no fallback
suggested_fix: Document the registry in WP marker guidance or enable fallback; arch completeness test catches it

summary: Vendored upstream_contract.json is the enforced authority for orchestrator-api command names and error codes; new verbs failed tests/contract/test_orchestrator_api.py outside the WP's owned_files and declared baseline.
root_cause: Enforced contract artifact not in owned_files; declared baseline too narrow
suggested_fix: Add upstream_contract.json to owned_files for new orchestrator-api verbs; treat as serialized same-file overlap across WPs

summary: upstream_contract.json, commands.py are same-file overlap surfaces across WP03/04/05/06/08; merge-order review must account for it.
root_cause: Parallel WPs each append to the same enforced registry
suggested_fix: Serialize or pre-allocate registry entries

summary: Duplicate-mission test flaky: mid8 is the high 40 bits of the ULID timestamp, so two specify calls separated by git I/O often land in different ~256ms windows and do not collide.
root_cause: Identity collision depends on real-time proximity
suggested_fix: Freeze ULID and now_utc_iso via monkeypatch

summary: Lane worktree has no .venv; the shared .venv is editable-installed against the main checkout src; gate commands fail 'No such file' until uv sync --frozen --all-extras runs inside the worktree.
root_cause: Venv not provisioned per lane worktree
suggested_fix: Provision/uv sync lane venv at implement time or document it in WP prompts

summary: The tasks verb (finalize_tasks) leaves .kittify/sync-state.json uncommitted, making record-analysis's dirty-tree preflight refuse with DIRTY_WORKTREE.
root_cause: Uncommitted side-effect file not in the bookkeeping-churn allowlist (sync residue)
suggested_fix: Stop writing sync-state.json or allowlist it

summary: record-analysis observed exiting 124 under a 300s timeout though the artifact was already written, due to unbounded trigger_feature_dossier_sync_if_enabled (SK-93).
root_cause: Unbounded dossier-sync trigger in record-analysis
suggested_fix: Bypass dossier sync or wrap in enforced timeout; use artifact re-read as success signal

summary: A bare # type: ignore[arg-type] in next_cmd.py was removed by narrowing a local to ProfileInvocationPhase — campsite fix rather than carrying the suppression into a public module.
Plan decision #1 named a shared test path in tests/specify_cli/cli/commands/ that would have been invisible to the diff-coverage gate; WP task file's tests/specify_cli/next/ path was correct.
root_cause: Plan did not check which CI roots instrument src/runtime/next
suggested_fix: Validate test placement against CI shard roots at plan time

summary: A pre-existing drift in the .kittify/overrides/ copy of analyze.md was flagged (Clarification 2); docs WP sequenced last to avoid drift.
suggested_fix: Document actual landed behavior only

summary: Contract validate_outbound_payload requires mission_slug; the raw tasks payload lacks it, in tension with 'raw pass-through' guidance; resolved with setdefault from validated identity.

finalize-tasks requirement-mapping validator has no notion of a conditionally-descoped FR; strikethrough ~~FR-004~~ is still captured, so a descoped FR had to be mapped into a WP as a documentation-only subtask.
root_cause: Validator requires every declared FR id to appear in some WP's requirement_refs
suggested_fix: Add a 'descoped' status/marker recognized by the unmapped-FR gate

summary: finalize-tasks _branch_strategy_text() is topology-blind, emitting dependency-specific-base wording for single_branch missions; hand-fix diverges and any non-validate-only re-run would silently regress it (SK-133).
root_cause: _branch_strategy_text takes only target/merge_target branch, never topology
suggested_fix: Make branch_strategy generator topology-aware

summary: generate_tasks_md_from_manifest renders requirement_refs verbatim with no per-ref status, so implemented vs traceability-only FRs look identical in tasks.md; YAML comments are parser-stripped (SK-132).
root_cause: No per-ref status field in manifest/renderer
suggested_fix: Add per-ref status to requirement_refs and render it

summary: finalize-tasks emits advisory ownership_warnings 'missing plan_concern_refs and cross_cutting is not set' for plans without IC-## headings — expected noise.
root_cause: Warning fires for plans that do not use IC-## convention
suggested_fix: Suppress warning when plan has no IC-## concerns

summary: finalize-tasks preserves hand-authored WP body prose (only rewrites changed frontmatter), so cross-WP sequencing notes belong in the body, not structured fields.
Task brief claimed the mission-loader-coverage CI gate applied, but that job covers src/specify_cli/mission_loader/, not src/specify_cli/mission.py — a false name-match.
root_cause: Brief inferred gate applicability from job name
suggested_fix: Verify gate scope against workflow YAML

summary: Citations drift fast within one session: a 'confirmed' finding's ci-quality.yml line range was already stale one round later.
suggested_fix: Re-read live source rather than trust citations one round old

summary: Spec phase needed two HALTs/operator rulings and plan phase needed four review/fix rounds (9+4+2+2 findings), largely on detector-mechanism detail and citation line numbers; ruling #2 diagnosed the spec was designing the detector instead of stating the requirement.
root_cause: Spec over-specified mechanism, inviting repeated independent audits of each restatement
suggested_fix: Keep spec at intent/outcome level; defer mechanism to plan

summary: Operator ruling #1 contained a factual error (claimed Scope—MoSCoW needed no new mechanism) reasoned from a finding summary instead of source; ruling #2 corrected it.
root_cause: Ruling issued without reading source first-hand
suggested_fix: Rulings must verify claims against source

summary: Early-stop rule applied: severity>=3 count did not decrease round-over-round, so round 4 was the last fix round with one verification pass.

#3831 SPLIT: legacy MissionConfig, modern MissionTypeProfile/expected-artifacts, and mission-runtime.yaml are three incompatible schemas with three resolvers; FR-004 org-tier lookup descoped to a follow-up (Refs #3831).
root_cause: Three independent mission-type schemas/resolvers
suggested_fix: Tracked follow-up reusing resolve_existing_org_roots precedence

summary: Review round found research.md paraphrased the CI critical_paths array inaccurately; replaced with verbatim 15-entry array.
suggested_fix: Quote CI config verbatim

summary: Design-decisions tracer has a duplicated trailing line ('research.md changed, plus this tracer append.') from an append slip.
Installed spec-kitty CLI is editable-installed from a sibling clone, so shell-out repros / live next verification exercise the wrong code unless PYTHONPATH-pinned.
root_cause: Global editable install points at another clone
suggested_fix: Pin PYTHONPATH=<lane>/src or scoped editable install for live proofs

summary: Repo's configured primary_branch was a stale topic branch (symbolkey-source-module-3552), so branch-context reported 'staying on main is fine' incorrectly.
root_cause: Stale primary_branch in config
suggested_fix: Validate primary_branch config against repo default branch

summary: Global pyenv python/pytest resolve specify_cli to the sibling clone; lane tests need PYTHONPATH=<lane>/src python -m pytest; uv run would destroy the hand-built .venv.
root_cause: Multiple installs of the same package across clones
suggested_fix: Document per-lane invocation; avoid uv run

summary: mark-status run inside the lane worktree polluted the lane with kitty-specs changes, blocking for_review; dependent-lane allocation auto-merge then conflicted on those kitty-specs, resolved with git merge -X ours.
root_cause: Status/kitty-specs writes landed on the lane branch instead of the planning surface
suggested_fix: Status commands should always target the planning/coord surface regardless of cwd

summary: Four adversarial point-cuts (post-spec x2, post-plan, post-tasks) caught five BLOCKERs before implementation (seam misplacement, terminal-surface ambiguity, deleted primitive, two-entry-point reconciliation).
suggested_fix: Keep squad point-cuts on architecturally loaded missions

summary: Live evidence (driving real decide_next_via_runtime) rather than static reading proved the #3780 stall fixed; pre-merge squad corrected query-mode kind to preserve is_query invariant.
Deferred perf items: board O(N) reductions and redundant primary-meta read; plus two #3780 secondary observations (redundant done_bookkeeping read, upstream_contract reason_source denylist).
suggested_fix: Coordinate with next-latency-durable-fix

summary: primary_feature_dir_for_mission was deleted; manual primary-path composition trips test_no_read_side_bypass (which does not sanction src/runtime/next/); must use sanctioned read_primary_meta primitives.
suggested_fix: Use sanctioned PRIMARY-surface primitives

summary: A new module consumed only by a later WP risks test_no_dead_modules/test_no_dead_symbols; give it an in-WP consumer.
suggested_fix: Ensure every new module has an importer within its own WP

summary: get_wp_lane fail-louds on absent log while wp_snapshot_state returns None silently; naive swap would break fail-loud contract — needed single reduce() with explicit event-log gate.
root_cause: Two read APIs with divergent missing-log semantics
suggested_fix: Unify missing-log semantics

summary: Implementation friction section left as '(append as encountered)' after only planning entries; approach tracer's close assessment is the richest record.
SaaS sync store locks on mission create (daemon boundary); had to run with SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC=0 SAAS_SYNC=0.

summary: finalize-tasks JSON reports only the last commit hash though it creates seven commits.

summary: record-analysis regenerated the dossier snapshot-latest.json but left it uncommitted; its auto-commit only covered analysis-report.md.

summary: Several suspected record-analysis defects (verdict unknown, untracked report, host path leak, hang-after-success) did not reproduce on this run; slowness distinguished from hang.
Subagent stranded waiting on a notification for its own background CLI invocation after it had already completed.
root_cause: Subagent blocked on its own background work instead of harness completion signal
suggested_fix: Dispatch hygiene: don't block on own background tasks

summary: agent action implement requires --mission even right after spec-kitty next resolved the mission unambiguously in the same session.

summary: agent action implement exceeded 120s foreground timeout, got backgrounded, and its output file was empty despite success; state had to be inferred from lanes.json/frontmatter/event log.

summary: No venv inside the lane worktree; root venv editable install silently tests the wrong copy unless PYTHONPATH=<worktree>/src is prepended — a maximally deceptive false-green risk.
root_cause: Single editable install at mission checkout root
suggested_fix: Verify specify_cli.__file__; provision per-worktree interpreter

summary: First test run triggers session-scoped test_venv fixture doing a ~1 min network pip install of the full dependency set.
root_cause: Isolated CLI test venv built lazily on first run

summary: safe-commit guard warns 'Protected path: implementation branches must not modify kitty-specs/' on tracer files that the charter tells implementers to append to during implementation.

suggested_fix: Carve out tracer files from the guard or redirect tracer writes to the planning surface

summary: After backgrounded implement WP02, every Bash call failed ENOSPC writing to harness task-output capture path; Write failed; Edit needed smaller anchors.
root_cause: Session sandbox resource exhaustion; possibly unbounded output from implement/event plumbing
suggested_fix: Investigate implement background-task output volume

summary: safe-commit warned ACTIVE_WP_CONTEXT_AMBIGUOUS on every commit because WP03 was never transitioned out of planned (dispatch forbade running the slow implement verb).

summary: Orchestrator-captured cumulative baseline was off by one (190 vs measured 189) before the WP made any change.

summary: agent tasks mark-status hung with zero output past 60-120s timeouts on three attempts; subtask status never recorded via the event-sourced command.

suggested_fix: Investigate mark-status hang

summary: diff-coverage --fail-under=90 only enforces a hardcoded critical_paths allowlist; validators/, acceptance/, cli/ are not in it, so it did not bind this mission's diff (only advisory).
root_cause: Enforced diff-cover limited to critical paths

summary: markdownlint ignores kitty-specs/**, so mission artifacts are exempt from the lint gate.

summary: Dedup fix is software-dev-specific (hardcoded _missing_artifacts literal list); research's data/ dual declaration not generalized; #3016/#2330 (convention correctness) out of scope.
root_cause: _missing_artifacts is mission-type-agnostic hardcoded list

summary: spec-kitty plan --json took >120s with 'project sync store is locked' / 'machine layout cutover did not publish' warnings (SK-63/65/70 family) before succeeding.
root_cause: Sync/event-journal lock contention (since-retired sync transport)
suggested_fix: See ledger SK-65; retired with sync

summary: Mission brief's blast-radius list mixed 'read to understand' with 'edited' files; step_projection.py was listed but correctly left unedited.
root_cause: Brief template lacks read-only vs edited distinction
suggested_fix: State read-only vs edited explicitly in blast-radius lists

summary: finalize-tasks silently overwrote every WP's planning_base_branch and branch_strategy with the mission's target_branch, erasing the stacked-parent anchor (fix/org-tier-expected-artifacts-3703) needed for red-first ATDD.
root_cause: planning_base_branch bootstrap unconditionally mirrors target_branch; no stacked-mission concept

summary: record-analysis hung and was killed (exit 124) three times with no --json output, though the report had already been committed (SK-93 dossier body-upload path).

suggested_fix: Verify via git log/status; fix the unbounded tail

summary: agent action implement WP01/WP02 hung past 60-120s (exit 124/143, zero output) though claim and worktree materialization had already succeeded; SK-93 recurring call site.

suggested_fix: Add implement to SK-93 call-site list; bound the tail

summary: agent tasks mark-status intermittently hung (exit 124) or printed a LayoutCutoverIncompleteError traceback while still succeeding; writes had already landed in status.events.jsonl.
root_cause: Machine layout cutover wait on the success path
suggested_fix: Make LayoutCutoverIncompleteError non-fatal/quiet; bound waits

summary: Across SK-93 occurrences, exit codes and printed output were weak evidence; ground truth had to be read from git log / status.events.jsonl every time.
suggested_fix: Tooling should print result before any slow tail work

summary: Tracer append committed on the lane branch's stale kitty-specs/ copy (safe-commit only warned); would have silently reverted planning-branch updates; only move-task --to for_review hard-blocked later.

summary: Lane worktrees do not carry the venv; relative .venv/bin/{mypy,ruff,python} paths in doctrine snippets and briefs fail; one agent borrowed ruff from an unrelated sibling checkout.

suggested_fix: State in WP briefs that lane worktrees lack the venv; use absolute paths

summary: safe-commit requires positional FILES and warns --to-branch will be mandatory in v3.3; generic 'use safe-commit' guidance and design-phase spec-commit step are under-specified.
root_cause: Guidance omits required arguments
suggested_fix: Update guidance with full invocation shape

summary: safe-commit emits ACTIVE_WP_CONTEXT_AMBIGUOUS / ACTIVE_WP_CONTEXT_STALE warnings on lane branches when no single WP is active; non-fatal and weak evidence.
root_cause: Active-WP inference assumes one in-progress WP per lane

summary: Manifest-consulting logic placed in runtime_bridge_io.py so the stdlib-only runtime_bridge_cores.py stays green under test_bridge_cores_import_boundary by construction.

mission create emitted sync-store-locked / event-routing / layout-cutover warnings (SK-65/SK-72) though scaffold succeeded; recorded on orchestrator's word.

summary: Scaffold auto-commit 'Add meta for feature <slug>' is commitlint-invalid and Terminology-Canon-violating (SK-64); later commitlint flagged 3 more type-less generated messages ('Add analysis report for mission', 'analyze(tracer):', 'tasks(reviews):').
root_cause: Generated commit message templates predate commitlint/terminology rules

summary: finalize-tasks lanes.json fabricates mission_branch kitty/mission-<slug> for a single_branch mission and predicts unrelated surfaces (SK-91).
root_cause: lanes.json generator ignores topology; surface predictor inaccurate
suggested_fix: Topology-aware lanes.json; fix/drop predicted_surfaces

summary: SK-85 (missing genesis event), SK-30 (branch_strategy pointing at protected branch) and SK-90 (letter-suffix FR ids) did not reproduce; telemetry warnings appeared around an already-durable write.
record-analysis wrote host-absolute paths (/home/<user>/...) into analysis-report.md input_artifacts frontmatter, leaking local filesystem layout into a public repo (SK-32 class).

summary: record-analysis did not return within 120s after sync-lock warnings, though the commit had already landed (SK-63 near-miss).
root_cause: Post-write sync tail stall

summary: Spec squad ran 4 R4->R5 rounds (one more than typical); each fresh sweep found a real narrow gap exposed by the prior round's added specificity.
Methodological trap (SK-81): two prior reviewers concluded the bug 'already fails' because they pre-seeded mission_type_activations, masking the defect; spec named the exact fixture shape.
root_cause: Nearest test helper conflates declaring a pack with setting activations
suggested_fix: Name required fixture shape explicitly in spec

summary: promote_activations() is a second, currently-inert write chokepoint onto commit_plan(); widening _PROMOTABLE_KINDS to mission-type could silently reopen the bug class.
suggested_fix: Documented as out-of-scope seam; gate it if kinds widen

summary: Non-goals boundary claims must be checked against the actual open PR diffs (PR #3707 touched the same test file), not just issue scope text.
suggested_fix: Check open PR diffs when writing non-goals

summary: No campsite-clean commit: both touched files were concurrently edited by three sibling open PRs; cleanup would only widen rebase-conflict surface.
RED shape chose AttributeError via module-attribute access over ImportError so the RED commit didn't break collection of the whole 62-test file.

summary: Spec phase omitted tracer-tooling-friction.md entirely while reporting 'deviations: none'; seeded only at plan phase.

suggested_fix: Scaffold all three tracers at mission create

summary: agent mission create auto-commits 'Add meta for feature <slug>' — commitlint-invalid and Terminology-Canon-violating (SK-64).

suggested_fix: Fix scaffold commit message

summary: safe-commit advisory deprecation warning: --to-branch required from v3.3.

summary: agent mission create commits meta.json but leaves its own status.events.jsonl and tasks/ untracked.

summary: test_no_dead_symbols allowlist entries are body-hash-keyed; adding a field to DeactivationPlan invalidates the entry, producing a confusing CI failure that looks like a regression.

summary: requirement_mapping.py regexes (\b(?:FR|NFR|C)-\d+\b) are blind to letter-suffixed ids like FR-005a, so WP frontmatter drift was not caught on either side.
root_cause: Regex matches only trailing digits (known gap also for C-007-mission ids)

summary: finalize-tasks is not idempotent: a validate-only preflight showed a mutating re-run would silently drop FR-005a from WP03 requirement_refs with a clean success.

summary: record-analysis returned promptly with a correct verdict (SK-06/SK-63 not triggered) when the carrier opened with '---' and schema line exactly; SK-32 host-absolute paths still reproduced.
record-analysis auto-committed analysis-report.md but left dossier snapshot-latest.json dirty in the same invocation — non-uniform commit behavior (SK-43 inverse).
root_cause: Command commits some artifacts it touches but not others
suggested_fix: Commit all generated artifacts atomically; callers must always check git status

summary: agent action implement hung in the dossier body-upload write-authority path (_await_publish_or_loud / body_queue.enqueue) even with SPEC_KITTY_SYNC_MINIMAL_IMPORT=1; killed at 300s.
root_cause: Store-authority write blocking in sync dossier pipeline, not covered by SK-72/65 env workaround

summary: agent action implement on a single_branch mission spun up a lane worktree contradicting the direct-checkout workspace the WP was dispatched into.
root_cause: implement always allocates a lane worktree
suggested_fix: Align implement allocation with dispatch/topology

summary: Same dossier write path produced four distinct failure shapes across WP01-WP03 (silent hang; raise then complete; raise then hang; 'sync store is locked' then hang exit 124); only git status is reliable.
root_cause: Unreliable write-authority path with inconsistent error handling
suggested_fix: Confirmed defect — fix SK-93; never trust exit code/stderr

summary: agent action implement completes status/workspace setup and auto-commits before reaching the dossier-sync hang; 'didn't return cleanly' does not mean 'nothing landed'.
WP04 bypassed agent action implement entirely (direct git/safe-commit), so SK-93 was not observed — absence of evidence, not a fix.
Mission brief claimed an existing test 'does not need weakening'; verified directly before trusting it (asserts only result.activated == {}).
suggested_fix: Verify brief claims against tests

summary: The pasted /spec-kitty.plan prompt was older than the repository's canonical mission-step prompt; planning followed the repo-local canonical source.
root_cause: Stale agent prompt copies drift from packs/built-in source
suggested_fix: Regenerate agent command copies via upgrade; prefer repo canonical prompts

summary: SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC=1 inherited from the environment triggered unauthenticated sync attempts and sync-store lock warnings; planning reran with sync disabled.
root_cause: Env var inherited into agent session (sync residue)

summary: Globally installed spec-kitty entry point had a broken module path for one research worker; repo-local uv run spec-kitty worked.

summary: Adversarial finding: SC-004 not met — committed Markdown review evidence could disappear under concurrent verdict saves (#3235).

summary: Queue released before event append so independent locks never nest; status lock kept short to preserve no-git-under-status-lock invariant.
Implementation-updates sections left as placeholders; tracers live under tracers/ (non-standard path) with Divio frontmatter.
agent mission create (and spec-kitty plan) emitted SK-65 sync-store-locked / layout-cutover warnings but completed.
root_cause: Machine layout stuck in CUTOVER_PENDING (since-retired sync plumbing)

summary: Pre-registered SK-63 mitigation: bound record-analysis, verify commit via git log/ls-tree not the success JSON, SIGTERM is clean, commit artifact via safe-commit.
root_cause: record-analysis prints success before commit then may hang
suggested_fix: Adopt verify-don't-trust protocol

summary: generate_tasks_md_from_manifest has no mission-level preamble/notes field and finalize-tasks overwrites tasks.md each run, so mission-wide baseline instructions had to be duplicated into every WP prompt.
root_cause: Deliberate fixed template; no notes slot
suggested_fix: Add optional mission-level notes/preamble field to WpsManifest

summary: finalize-tasks re-run wrote its mutations then hung forever in a sync retry loop (hrtimer_nanosleep); SPEC_KITTY_SYNC_DISABLE=1 did not prevent it; four of four invocations hung (SK-74).
root_cause: Sync retry loop not gated by disable env var
suggested_fix: Fix SK-74; don't re-run finalize-tasks until fixed

summary: Because finalize-tasks hung, the round-2 tasks fix pass had to hand-edit plan.md and WP files without regeneration, deviating from the canonical flow.
root_cause: SK-74 hang
suggested_fix: Fix SK-74

summary: A truncated evidence quote in round 1 hid a contradictory clause in the same sentence; the stale phrase survived two review rounds until a fresh sweep re-read the full line.
root_cause: Partial evidence excerpts treated as proof of 'already fixed'
suggested_fix: Quote full sentences as evidence; re-read files rather than trust prior excerpts

summary: WP04 pointed to a 'tasks.md preamble' that never existed (consequence of the no-notes-field gap).
root_cause: tasks.md has no preamble capability
suggested_fix: Keep WP prompts self-contained

summary: record-analysis leaked four host-absolute paths into analysis-report.md (SK-63 secondary); manually rewritten to repo-relative before commit because the repo is public.
root_cause: analysis_report.py recorded str(absolute path) (this mission's FR-007 fixes it)
suggested_fix: Relativize against repo_root / canonical_root per entry

summary: record-analysis without --input-file defaulted to stdin and failed 'Analysis report body is empty' when backgrounded.

summary: Mission-wide baseline (86 tests) captured independently by three concurrent WPs with no coordination because tasks.md couldn't host it; ~106-124s each.
agent action implement printed the lane-ready banner then hung >3 min in a retry sleep (SK-65) though workspace was fully materialized; SIGTERM required.
root_cause: Event-routing retry loop after useful work
suggested_fix: Bound the tail

summary: mark-status from lane-a wrote its event to the PRIMARY checkout then hung; concurrent WPs' mark-status calls raced the same shared status.events.jsonl, so WPs could not safely commit it.
root_cause: Shared status surface written concurrently by parallel WP agents
suggested_fix: Serialize status writes or have the orchestrator own status commits

summary: mark-status hung twice for WP04 with zero commit and zero working-tree change (unlike implement which committed before hanging); subtask status left unrecorded.
root_cause: SK-65/SK-74 sync-store lock retry
suggested_fix: Fix sync-store hang

summary: WP04 rejected because BEFORE/AFTER checks were manual due diligence, not a persisted test; remediation verified red->green by running the new test against the pre-trim commit in a throwaway worktree.
suggested_fix: Persist red-first regressions as tests

summary: CLAUDE.md's __init__.py version-bump rule was read as not applying to nested package __init__.py (precedent a69c2f04a); ambiguity in the rule.
root_cause: CLAUDE.md rule wording ambiguous for nested packages
suggested_fix: Clarify the version-bump rule scope

summary: Dossier emitter guard is a syntactic AST matcher resolving only on final attribute name; no data-flow or dynamic-dispatch tracking (accepted limits).
suggested_fix: Document limits in guard docstring

summary: Commit-subject fix (docs(<scope>):) chosen over widening commitlint ignores; SK-64 measured 2 of 52 mission commits failing commitlint from this message.
suggested_fix: Give tool-authored commits conventional types

summary: Charter path must relativize against canonical_root (not repo_root) to preserve #1823 cross-worktree behavior; a uniform rule would break a green regression test.
specify and plan emitted sync-store-locked / layout-cutover warnings; plan exceeded 120s and was backgrounded (SK-65).
root_cause: Sync store lock contention (since-retired)

summary: coord-topology mission scaffolded on protected main: safe-commit --to-branch main refused (protected), --to-branch <coord-branch> refused because HEAD not on it, and moving HEAD was forbidden — deadlock, BLOCKED.
root_cause: coord minted a coordination branch with no checked-out worktree; safe-commit won't check out for the caller
suggested_fix: Scaffold via agent mission create --start-branch; safe-commit/spec-commit should land on coord branch via its worktree

summary: Orchestrator brief confused 'mission create' (tracker-ticket fetcher, --from-ticket) with 'agent mission create' (has --start-branch); two similarly named commands with different semantics.
root_cause: Overlapping command names
suggested_fix: Disambiguate command naming/help

summary: spec-commit's documented materialize-then-retry fallback materialized a coord worktree from HEAD without the uncommitted mission files, so the retry failed identically (placement_ref still main) — SK-12 not fixed on 3.2.6rc3.
root_cause: Materialized worktree does not receive caller's uncommitted planning files
suggested_fix: Relocate/stage authored files into the materialized worktree, or commit via plumbing to the coord ref

summary: Resolution: operator-authorized re-scaffold with agent mission create --start-branch, which moves HEAD off main before topology derivation so it resolves to single_branch; old scaffold torn down after confirming no unique commits.
suggested_fix: Default planning to a non-protected start branch

summary: agent mission create --start-branch auto-commit message 'Add meta for feature <slug>' lacks conventional type and uses prohibited 'feature' term.
root_cause: Legacy commit template
suggested_fix: Fix commit message

summary: Background job pinned to an isolated agent worktree refused any git command after cd into the shared primary checkout and refused Write/Edit there; compound heredoc commands refused as 'too complex'. Workaround: cd && non-git binary; write scripts in scratchpad and run 'bash script'.
root_cause: Harness worktree-isolation sandbox conflicts with single_branch topology in primary checkout
suggested_fix: Document the scratchpad-script pattern; reconcile harness isolation with single_branch missions

summary: finalize-tasks returned success with all dependencies empty and all lanes parallel_group 0 because WP frontmatter declared dependencies: [] while tasks.md prose stated a linear chain; no contradiction check.
root_cause: Tier-2 frontmatter dependencies authoritative over tasks.md prose, with no cross-check (initially misdiagnosed as parser no-op)
suggested_fix: Warn when frontmatter dependencies contradict tasks.md prose

summary: After fixing frontmatter dependencies, finalize-tasks produced the correct lane chain; mutating re-run stalled ~95s on layout-cutover warning; bookkeeping commit succeeded because branch was non-protected (SK-60 avoided).
record-analysis leaked host-absolute paths (/home/<user>/...) into the committed PUBLIC analysis-report.md and stayed resident >2.5 min after its commit landed.
root_cause: analysis_report.py recorded absolute paths; post-commit sync stall
suggested_fix: Relativize paths; bound post-commit tail

summary: WP01 implementer never ran agent action implement, working directly in the primary checkout; no lane worktree or status transitions were driven, so the implement command was never exercised.
root_cause: Implementer skipped canonical loop
suggested_fix: Orchestrator should require/verify implement transitions

summary: Editing src while a long background baseline ran caused 5 NameError failures in test_execution_context_parity (subprocesses import fresh from disk mid-edit).

suggested_fix: Never edit src while a baseline that spawns subprocesses is running

summary: Deleting the local Pydantic mirror removed ContentHashRef hash lowercasing; test_lowercases_hash went red and was retired (normalization was possible via .lower() but deliberately not added).

summary: Final targeted validation ran -n0 to avoid the sync suite's known xdist flakiness; ~12 minutes for tests/architectural + dossier/sync scope.
root_cause: Known xdist flakiness in sync suite
suggested_fix: Fix sync-suite xdist flakiness

summary: None of the CI jobs collecting this mission's tests carry a --cov-fail-under floor; only SonarCloud's project gate protects new-test coverage; an earlier plan draft misnamed nonexistent CI jobs.

summary: Plan review found diagnose.py as an unaccounted _PAYLOAD_RULES consumer (sev 5) that the sentinel would crash; had to be promoted to its own FR-011.

summary: Plain MagicMock @patch without autospec would not go red on a reverted signature promotion; broad except Exception in dossier_pipeline hides behavior; real unmocked end-to-end test required.
suggested_fix: Require real-call tests for behavior behind broad except handlers

summary: coord topology was initially chosen on protected main to avoid SK-57/SK-36/SK-09 branch-flat traps, but proved non-viable at commit time.
Queue-drain half of #1058 superseded by mission #3293; canonical validate_event() usable now without waiting for spec-kitty-events#50.
